mapping.summary: Approval workflow and validation for vendor bank account changes
claims: Approval workflow for vendor bank account changes using the BC approval engine
Vendor bank accounts have Open, Pending Approval and Released statuses
Only released bank accounts can be used in payments
Blocks posting payment journal lines that use non-released vendor bank accounts
Expiration date on vendor bank accounts blocks payments after expiry
Enforces IBAN on vendor bank accounts before payment
Validates preferred bank account has Released status
Released or pending vendor bank accounts cannot be deleted
SEPA credit transfers and payment exports enforce status, IBAN and expiry checks
Validates IBANs live through external services
Retrieves bank name, address and BIC/SWIFT from IBAN
Field locking on approved bank accounts
Comments and overdue approval request management
Credentials stored in BC Isolated Storage
